questions.question: At St George's Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
At which ground did Dané van Niekerk record their career-best innings (100, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2022/23 season?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Badgers?
How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Leah Jones) and #2 (Nosipho Vezi) wicket-takers (combined T20 + List A) in the 22/23 season?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones: 26 — Nosipho Vezi: 25 — a gap of 1.
